descriptive traits.personality trait: I pause to offer a quiet blessing before any task that matters.
descriptive traits.ideal: Devotion: My service to a temple shapes every decision I make.
descriptive traits.bond: I owe my education and my calling to the clergy who raised me.
descriptive traits.flaw: I quote scripture at the worst possible moments.

descriptive traits.personality trait: I always have an exit planned before I walk into a room.
descriptive traits.ideal: Survival: Rules are for people who can afford to follow them.
descriptive traits.bond: An old partner is still serving time for a job I walked away from.
descriptive traits.flaw: I can't pass up an unlocked door or an unattended purse.

descriptive traits.personality trait: I annotate everything I read, including things I probably shouldn't.
descriptive traits.ideal: Inquiry: No question is too small to chase to its answer.
descriptive traits.bond: A mentor's unfinished research is mine to complete.
descriptive traits.flaw: I'd rather argue a point than let it go unresolved.

descriptive traits.personality trait: I size up the exits and the high ground in any new place.
descriptive traits.ideal: Discipline: Orders exist to keep people alive, mine included.
descriptive traits.bond: I carry the kit of a comrade who didn't make it home.
descriptive traits.flaw: I follow orders first and ask questions never.
